cases.name: CHK-001 happy: reconcile script drains the historical B-6246 open bugs
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); return execFileSync('npm', ['run', 'test:b6246-bug-cleanup'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: current B-6246 bug list no longer contains the old visible open bug ids
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const raw = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', '--root', $root, 'bug_list', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-6246' })], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }); const data = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); const openIds = new Set(data.bugs.filter((b) => b.status === 'open').map((b) => b.id)); return { noH0: !openIds.has('BUG-fid-test-h0'), noH1: !openIds.has('BUG-fid-test-h1'), noOld: !openIds.has('BUG-old-format'), noDang: !openIds.has('BUG-dangling-v2'), noReject: !openIds.has('BUG-reject-v2') };

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: if cleanup stopped working the same five ids would reappear as open
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const raw = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', '--root', $root, 'bug_list', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-6246' })], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }); const data = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); const openIds = new Set(data.bugs.filter((b) => b.status === 'open').map((b) => b.id)); return { catchesRegression: !openIds.has('BUG-fid-test-h0') && !openIds.has('BUG-old-format') };

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: fixture-bug-binding no longer hardcodes B-6246 for bug pollution cases
cases.execute: const { readFileSync } = await import('fs'); const text = readFileSync($root + '/packages/main/tests/fixtures/fixture-bug-binding.json', 'utf8'); return { noHardcodedBugStory: !text.includes('storyId:"B-6246"'), usesTempStories: text.includes('$testStory') };

cases.name: CHK-002 edge: legacy bugs without fixtureId can now be cleaned through bug_update
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, rmSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-legacy-bug-clean-')); try { mkdirSync(join(dir, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(dir, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'index.json'), JSON.stringify({ storyId:'B-test', name:'x', title:'x', description:'x', type:'bug', phase:'DONE', priority:'medium', createdAt:new Date().toISOString(), startedAt:new Date().toISOString(), endedAt:new Date().toISOString() }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(dir, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'bug.json'), JSON.stringify({ bugs:[{ id:'BUG-old', title:'old style bug', status:'open', foundAt:new Date().toISOString(), fixedAt:null }] }, null, 2)); const out = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', '--root', dir, 'bug_update', JSON.stringify({ storyId:'B-test', id:'BUG-old', status:'fixed' })], { cwd:$root, encoding:'utf8' }); return { cleaned: out.includes('legacy bug without fixtureId') }; } finally { rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-002 adversarial: stale fixtureId cleanup still uses bug_update instead of hand-editing bug.json
cases.execute: const { readFileSync } = await import('fs'); const text = readFileSync($root + '/packages/main/src/handlers/bug.ts', 'utf8'); return { hasStaleCleanup: text.includes('staleFixtureCleanup'), hasLegacyCleanup: text.includes('legacyFixtureCleanup') };

cases.name: CHK-003 edge: cleanup verification does not touch already fixed B-6246 bug records
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const raw = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', '--root', $root, 'bug_list', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-6246' })], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }); const data = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); return { keepsFixed: data.bugs.some((b) => b.id === 'BUG-fix-v2' && b.status === 'fixed') && data.bugs.some((b) => b.id === 'BUG-fix8-1775435194470' && b.status === 'fixed') };

cases.name: CHK-003 adversarial: if open bug debt comes back the cleanup verification fails
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const raw = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', '--root', $root, 'bug_list', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-6246' })], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }); const data = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); return { noOpenBugs: data.bugs.every((b) => b.status === 'fixed') };
